name: [🎨] Hide In Paintings
desc:
Welcome to Hide In Paintings! 👋

Play against another player and try to hide! Paint your character to match the background picture. The player who blends in the best wins the round. Be the first to win 2 rounds to win the whole game!

👍LIKE + JOIN GROUP👍

Our Game Supports
💻 PC | 🎮 Console | 📱 Mobile

Invite your friends to get even more fun! 🤗
Play with friends for FREE on our free private servers! 🎮

This game is inspired by Mecca Chameleon.
